title: StageRecord
description: One stage as the document stores it.

version.description: The version of the stage's contract: which schema its settings and output follow.

depends_on.description:
The hash of the input the stage read, so staleness can be worked out on load. Absent until
the stage has run.

settings.description: The settings the stage ran with (or will run with).

output.description: What the stage returned. Absent until the stage has run.

river.description:
The river stage's output: the centreline (from the mouth when one is stated), the river
polygon with its islands, and the water level profile on river chainage.

settings.description: The method and the settings of each method.

seed.description: Seed legs to join first, for the rolling circle.

constraints.description:
The run's constraints (ticket 13): the re-route avoids the no-go areas and weighs its cut by
the multiplier; every method's line reports the no-go areas it touches.

volumes.description:
The volumes stage's section settings, which the river-following line costs with (the one
scorer). Absent: the defaults.

centreline.description: The centreline: the one given, or the smoothed line midway between the banks.

banks.description: The banks, each turned to run the way the centreline runs; `None` unless both are given.

length_m.description: The length of the centreline in metres.

stations_checked.description: How many stations the bank checks looked at (zero without two banks).

side_fail_stations.description: How many of them failed the side check.

bank_checks.description: The stations that failed a check, in chainage order.

banks_cross.description: Where the two banks cross, if they do (the checks report it, they never repair it).

reversed.description: True when the lines were turned round so that they start at the mouth.

mouth.description: The mouth: the first point of the centreline, when a mouth was stated.

water_profile.description:
The water profile. Its chainage is from the mouth when one was stated (the profile is turned
with the line when the line is); with no mouth, it is from the start of the line as given.

Polyline.description: A line in the project CRS: `[x, y]` points in order.

Banks.description: The two banks, both running the way the centreline runs.

RiverPolygon.description:
The river as water: an outer ring and the islands cut out of it. A ring is a [`Polyline`] that is
closed by implication (the last point joins the first).

holes.description: Islands: each is dry land inside the shell.

BankCheck.description: One station that failed a bank check.

chainage_m.description: Chainage of the station along the banks' reference line, in metres.

checks.description:
The names of the checks it failed: `side`, `missing`, `jump`, `width-wide`, `width-narrow`,
`excursion`, `crossing`.

WaterProfile.description:
The water level along a river: points sorted by chainage, read linearly between points and held
flat beyond the first and last. Two points at one chainage make a step (a weir): at that chainage
the later point holds.

WaterPoint.description:
One point of a water level profile: a river chainage and the level there, in metres. It is
written as the pair `[chainage, level]`.

ChannelSize.description:
What the sizing stage returns: the channel's size and why. The keys are the ones the document has
always stored under `stages.sizing.results`.

rule_sets.description: The selection that sized it, such as `pianc-wg141@0.3.0 (se_quality C)`.

vessel_standard_id.description: The class's catalogue id; null for a custom vessel.

loa_m.description: The vessel's length overall in metres.

bottom_width_straight_m.description: The bottom width of the channel on a straight, in metres.

min_bend_radius_m.description: The minimum bend radius in metres.

bend_widening_at_rmin_m.description: The bend widening at the minimum radius, in metres.

bottom_width_at_rmin_m.description: The bottom width at the minimum radius, in metres.

source.description: Where the vessel's figures come from.

vessel_label.description: A custom vessel's label (it has no class id); absent for a class.

design_basis.description: B, the design basis: each quantity with its governing Rule.

rules_notice.description: The notice every output carries while the Rules are unverified.

BasisRow.description: One row of the design basis: a quantity with the Rule that governs it.

waterway.description: The waterway kind of the reach, for the minimum radius.

rule_sets.description: The sets that hold the Rule, as `id@version`.

other_rules.description: The other Rules of the Requirement that have a limit.

OtherRule.description: Another Rule of a Requirement, with its limit.

AlignmentSettings.description:
The settings of the alignment stage: the method that makes the design line, one typed part per
method under the method's name, and the given line, as the document holds them. Each method
knows its own keys only.

method.description: The method that makes the one design line.

river_following.description:
The river-following line's settings (OPT-4). Written only when one is not its default, so a
design that never set them keeps its settings, and its hashes, as before the method existed.

given.description: The line the user gave, for the method `given`.

AlignMethod.description: A way of finding a design line.

oneOf.description: The rolling circle (water-aware when there is a river polygon).
The least-cost re-route over the terrain.

The river centreline as it is, with no repair: a line to compare with. It may be tighter
than the minimum radius; its checks say so.
A line the user gives (ticket C21).

The river-following line (OPT-4): arcs and straights that follow the river as closely as
R_min allows, with meander cut-throughs as an explicit choice.

RollingCircleSettings.description: The settings of the rolling circle, typed.

check_chord_m.description: The chord the minimum radius is read on; `None`: a third of R_min.

use_water.description: Keep the line in the water; `None`: when the document has a river polygon.

RerouteSettings.description: The settings of the least-cost re-route, typed.

corridor_sweep_m.description: The half-widths of the corridors to try, in metres.

fairness_weight.description: The fairness weight; `None` (a document from before spec 0005) reads as 0.

CentrelineSettings.description: The settings of the river centreline as a design line: the chord its radius is read on.

check_chord_m.description: The chord the minimum radius is read on; `None`: a third of R_min.

RiverFollowingSettings.description:
The settings of the river-following line, typed. Each length left unset is worked out from the
sizing stage when the line is built, and the line records the value it used.

seed_clip_ratio.description: The seed's least radius as a multiple of R_min.

cut_radius_ratio.description: The radius of a cut-through's arcs as a multiple of R_min.

shift_limit_ratio.description: The sideways shift's radius limit as a multiple of R_min.

min_straight_m.description:
The straight between two opposite arcs when either is tighter than 2 R_min, in metres;
unset: the vessel's length.

seed_tolerance_m.description:
The largest gap of the seed from the river centreline outside a bend tighter than R_min, in
metres; unset: 5 m, or an eighth of the bottom width when that is more. At 5 m a smooth
bend is one arc with straights between; at 2 m it becomes a compound curve of three arcs.

seed_presmooth_m.description: The moving average of the centreline before the seed is fitted, in metres; unset: R_min / 6.

cut_min_save_m.description: A cut-through saves at least this length, in metres; unset: twice the vessel's length.

cut_min_ratio.description: The river stretch a cut-through replaces is at least this many times the cut's length.

cut_max_arc_turn_deg.description: Each arc of a cut-through turns at most this, in degrees.

cut_min_gain.description:
A cut-through is taken only when it is at least this share cheaper than staying in the
river (a tie goes to the river).

face_max_m.description: A cut-through whose tallest face is over this (and over staying's) is refused, in metres.

cut_force.description: Cut-throughs forced on (`true`) or off (`false`) by id; this wins over the rule.

in_river_margin_m.description: The river polygon grown (+) or shrunk (−) for the in-river tests, in metres.

cut_through_room_m.description:
The room either side of an accepted cut-through the shift may use, in metres; unset: twice
the bottom width.

shift_reach_m.description: The largest sideways offset, in metres; unset: the larger of 150 m and R_min / 2.

shift_station_m.description: The shift's station spacing, in metres; unset: R_min / 6, from 20 to 50 m.

shift_offset_step_m.description: The shift's offset step, in metres; unset: from the station spacing and R_min (spec 4.8).

shift_max_slope.description: The steepest sideways slope of the shift.

shift_refine.description: Refine the shift after the dynamic programme.

same_curves.description: Keep the seed's curves and straights in the shift (spec 4.5).

widening_levels.description: The bottom widths the shift's cost tables are built at, to price bend widening.

turn_weight.description: A price on turning in the shift, per metre of line per unit of R_min × curvature (0: off).

check_chord_m.description: The chord the radius check reads on; unset: R_min / 3.

oneOf.description: The river's water: at a bend tighter than R_min, the arc that keeps most of the line in it.

GivenLine.description:
A line the user already has (ticket C21), given as the design line: its name and its points in
the project CRS.

name.description: The name the user gave it.

line.description: The line, in the project CRS: a GeoJSON `LineString`.

SeedLegs.description: Seed legs (spec 0005): lines joined first, with pieces the joined line must hold.

start_pose.description: The pose the joined line must start with.

end_pose.description: The pose the joined line must end with.

must_follow.description: Lines the joined line must follow exactly.

PoseIn.description: A pose: a point and a heading in degrees counter-clockwise from the project CRS's +x axis.

Constraints.description: The run's constraints: `inputs.constraints`. Absent from a document that has none.

name.description: The name, unique among the run's no-go areas.

kind.description: What it is, in the engineer's words (free text).

polygon.description: The area, in the project CRS.

Area.description: A polygon in the project CRS: an outer ring and holes. A ring is closed by implication.

holes.description: Holes: ground inside the shell that is not part of the area.

MultiplierRaster.description: The cut-rate multiplier raster, by reference, as the DEM is: it is never embedded.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, in hex.

nodata.description: The value that marks no data, if the file has one. No data multiplies by 1.

VolumesSettings.description: The settings of the volumes stage, typed. A key the stage does not know is refused by name.

maxw_m.description: The half-width of each cross-section in metres.

dx_m.description: The sample spacing across each cross-section in metres.

wet_slope.description: The slope of the cut below water, horizontal per vertical.

half_width_m.description: A fixed bottom half-width in metres; `None`: widened in bends from the sizing.

DesignLine.description: What the alignment stage returns: the one design line, how it was made and what it does.

line.description:
The line, from the mouth when the design states one: a GeoJSON `LineString` in the project
CRS, as every line of the document is.

checks.description:
The checks of the line: `r_min_m`, `radius_ok`, `measured_min_radius_m`,
`radius_check_chord_m`, and `fits_in_water`, `feasible` and `join_guard` where they apply.
`no_go_clear` (`{ok, footprint_width_m, note}`) when the run has constraints: `ok` is false when
the footprint enters a no-go area or hard-exclusion ground.

details.description: What the method reports about its own work.

sanity.description: The design sanity check of the line: `{checked, warnings}`.

widening_floor.description: How a bend of this line widens, when not by the rules (`none` for the river centreline).

cut_offs.description:
Where the line leaves the river's water: a list, empty when it never leaves it. Spec 0017
writes `cut_offs[]`; this is `null` instead of a list when they were not worked out (no river
polygon to tell water from land, or a line moved from a 0.4 file), so "none" and "not known"
never read the same.

constraints_touched.description:
The no-go areas and the hard-exclusion ground (multiplier at or above 1e6) the line's channel
footprint enters (ticket 13), each with the chainage from and to, the area touched and the
footprint width tested. The footprint is the straight bottom width only: the cut slopes and
bend widening are not tested. Empty when it enters none, or the run has none.

river_following.description:
What a river-following line (OPT-4) records about itself: its seed, its cut-throughs, its
forced stretches and its shift. Absent for a line of any other method.

Bend.description: One bend of a design line.

from.description: Design-line chainage where the bend starts.

to.description: Design-line chainage where the bend ends.

radius_m.description: The least radius in the bend, in metres, read the way the radius check reads it.

r_min_m.description: The minimum radius the sizing allows, in metres.

pass.description: True when the radius meets R_min (within the radius check's tolerance).

Chainage.description:
Distance along a river or a design line, in metres. Chainage 0 is at the river mouth when the river
states one (spec 0017); with no mouth stated, it is at the start of the line as it was given.

CutOff.description: One stretch where the design line leaves the river's water: a cut-off of the river reach between.

from.description: Design-line chainage where the line leaves the water.

to.description: Design-line chainage where it comes back.

river_from.description: River chainage where it leaves the river.

river_to.description: River chainage where it rejoins the river.

ConstraintTouched.description:
One no-go area, or one stretch of hard-exclusion ground, a design line's footprint enters: where
along the line, and how much of the footprint is in it. A line that enters one area twice touches
it twice. The footprint is the channel's straight bottom width only, `footprint_width_m` wide,
centred on the line: the cut slopes and bend widening are not tested.

name.description: The no-go area's name; for hard-exclusion ground, the multiplier raster's path.

kind.description: The no-go area's kind; `hard_exclusion` for multiplier cells at or above 1e6.

from.description: Design-line chainage where the footprint enters it.

to.description: Design-line chainage where the footprint leaves it.

area_m2.description:
The area of the footprint inside it, m². A no-go area is sampled every [`TOUCH_STEP_M`]
along the line and [`TOUCH_ACROSS_M`] across it; hard-exclusion ground every half cell of
the raster both ways.

footprint_width_m.description:
The width of the footprint tested, metres: the channel's straight bottom width only. The cut
slopes and bend widening are not tested.

RiverFollowingRecord.description:
What the river-following line records about itself (spec OPT-4, section 6). The window optimiser
(OPT-5) reads [`RiverFollowingRecord::permitted_stretches`] from it for its permitted ground.

settings.description: The settings, every one as used.

derived.description: The lengths worked out from the sizing.

cut_throughs.description: Every cut-through candidate, in chainage order.

forced.description: The forced stretches of the delivered line, in chainage order.

low_line_mismatch.description: Where the river polygon and the ground's low line disagree (with a DEM).

Derived.description:
The lengths the method used, worked out from the sizing stage and the settings. The line
records them, so a reader sees that each came from R_min, the vessel or the bottom width.

seed_tolerance_m.description: The seed's tolerance to the centreline.

r_cut_m.description: The radius of a cut-through's arcs.

tight_reverse_r_m.description: Opposite arcs tighter than this need the minimum straight (2 R_min).

curve_threshold_per_m.description: A bend of the river curves at least this much, 1/m (1 / 8 R_min).

off_river_min_m.description: A stretch of the line out of the river is recorded when at least this long (2 × LOA).

SeedRecord.description: The seed, as the line records it.

gap_m.description: The largest gap from the river centreline (smoothed) outside the tight bends, m.

gap_all_m.description: The largest gap anywhere, the tight bends too, m.

passes.description: Refinement passes, and whether the gap outside the tight bends is within the tolerance.

bends.description:
Each bend: its arc, its radius, its gap to the centreline, and whether it is a tight bend
held at the seed's least radius.

ElementRecord.description: One element of a line: a straight or an arc.

start.description: Design-line chainage of its start, m.

radius_m.description: Its radius, m; null for a straight.

start_point.description: Its start point and heading (degrees counter-clockwise from +x).

BendRecord.description: One bend of the seed, for the app's list.

from.description: Seed chainage of the arc, from and to.

gap_m.description: The largest gap of the line from the centreline round the bend, m.

tight.description:
Held at the seed's least radius because the river is tighter (or moved to hold the minimum
straight).

CutThroughRecord.description: A cut-through candidate, accepted or refused, with both sets of numbers.

id.description:
A stable id from the river chainage of its two ends, to 100 m: `cut-AAAAA-BBBBB` in
hectometres. A force list names it.

seed_from.description: Seed chainage of its two ends.

river_from.description: River chainage of its two ends.

stay.description: Staying in the river over the stretch.

options.description: The radii tried: the cut-through radius, then wider ones.

passes.description: True when the offered option passes the rule.

refused_because.description: Why it was not taken, in words.

from.description: Design-line chainage of the cut, when accepted.

Numbers.description: The numbers of one way through a stretch (staying in the river, or a cut-through).

wet_m3.description: Dredge (cut below the water level), m³.

cost.description: The weighted cost, as the scorer weighs it.

land_m2.description: The channel's water surface outside the river polygon, m².

face_max_m.description: The tallest cut face above the water, m.

stations_over_face.description: Stations whose face is over `face_max_m` of the settings.

CutOptionRecord.description: One radius a cut-through was tried at.

ratio.description: The river stretch's length over the cut's.

line.description: The cut's centre line, for the map.

ForcedStretch.description:
A stretch of the line the river forces: a bend tighter than the seed may follow, or a
stretch out of the river not chosen as a cut-through.

id.description: A stable name: `forced-` and the river chainage of its middle, to 100 m.

kind.description:
`tight_bend`: the river is tighter than R_min allows; `straight`: the seed left the river
to hold the minimum straight between opposite arcs; `off_river`: the line's centre is out
of the river (with the margin) for at least `off_river_min_m`.

river_radius_m.description: The river's tightest radius there (a tight bend), m.

farthest_from_centreline_m.description: The farthest the line is from the river centreline in the stretch, m.

ShiftRecord.description: The sideways shift, as the line records it.

offsets.description: The offset at each station, m (+ left).

cost_zero.description: The search cost at zero shift, and after.

share_moved.description: The share of stations moved by at least half an offset step.

closed.description: True when the end closed at zero offset and zero slope.

refined_passes.description: The refinement's passes that moved the line.

tracking_gap_m.description: The largest gap between the shifted line and the delivered arcs, m.

rebuilt.description: True when the shifted line was built again (the shift moved it and saved cost).

tracked.description:
True when it was built in exact 5 m steps, because its arcs missed it by more than the
tolerance.

held_stations.description: Stations where the shift was held at zero because the arcs could not follow it there.

dropped.description: True when the shift was not delivered: its arcs could not follow it even held.

RiverChecks.description: The checks of section 7, each read from the line and the polygon.

tangency_max_rad.description: The largest heading jump at an element join, rad.

short_reversals.description:
Opposite arcs either tighter than 2 R_min with a straight shorter than the minimum:
`[chainage, straight length]`.

off_river_unexplained.description:
Stretches out of the river (with the margin) at least `off_river_min_m` long that no
accepted cut-through or forced stretch holds: `[from, to]` chainage. Empty: the check
passes. Null when the design has no river polygon.

largest_from_centreline_m.description: The largest and the mean distance of the line from the river centreline, m.

share_outside.description: The share of the line's length whose centre is out of the river (with the margin).

tracking_gap_ok.description: The tracking gap within the tolerance.

force_unmatched.description: Forced ids that matched no candidate.

LowLineMismatch.description:
The data check: stretches where the river polygon's middle and the ground's low line are more
than half a bottom width apart (spec 8). A warning, never a move of the line.

largest_m.description: The largest distance between the two, m.
